title: Intermittent batch-poisoning events: diagnosis, mitigations, and follow-ups
creator: Ava Patel
description: Summary: Over a two-week window we observed intermittent 'batch-poisoning' episodes where a small number of long-running or mis-sized requests caused the continuous batcher to stall formation for multiple slots, producing tail-latency spikes and unfair slot allocation across traffic classes. Impact: ~3% of user requests across hosted regions experienced >5x tail latency for 1-3 minute windows during each incident; incident correlated with fleet autoscaling activity and a recent scheduler micro-optimization deployed in runtime-1.22. Goals: 1) ship short-term mitigations to avoid repeated customer-facing spikes, 2) implement medium-term fairness and eviction policies, 3) harden testing and observability to detect recurrence and prevent regressions.
action_items: Short-term: implement a per-slot 'formation-age' circuit breaker that forces accepted-but-unstarted requests to requeue after 200ms; owner: Diego Ramos; estimate: 3
Short-term: add a heuristic to drain requests with malformed size hints that consistently exceed expected token counts; owner: Sophie Chen; estimate: 2
Short-term: rate-limit and backpressure integration with autoscaler to prevent correlated large-batch bursts during pool scale-up; owner: Liam O'Neill; estimate: 2
Medium-term: design and implement a priority-aware fairness rebalancer that moves stalled requests into lower-priority buckets and reorders formation windows; owner: Priya Sethi; estimate: 8
Medium-term: align KV-cache eviction policy with batch-window boundaries to avoid cache thrashing when batches are delayed; owner: Diego Ramos; estimate: 5
Long-term: refactor scheduler to expose deterministic slot leasing and preemption hooks for better observability and testing; owner: Engineering Platforms; estimate: 13
Long-term: create synthetic "poison" workload in our test harness to validate fairness, coalescence, and recovery within CI; owner: Test Infrastructure; estimate: 8
Operations: add an alert that triggers when >0.5% of requests in a 1-minute window exceed 3x P95 and when batch formation time exceeds 150ms for 30s; owner: SRE; estimate: 1
Documentation: update the batching design doc with new fairness guarantees and failure modes; owner: Diego Ramos; estimate: 1
acceptance_criteria: Circuit breaker prevents repeated slot formation stalls in production canary for two weeks without false positives
Fairness rebalancer reduces inter-class latency variance by >=40% on the synthetic poison workload
Automated tests cover at least 3 failure modes (long-tail requests, malformed size hints, autoscaler bursts) in CI
New alerts fire within expected thresholds and on-call runbooks include remediation steps
